name: Ganryu Kodama
want: take the Seiryo baseball team to Koshien before he turns forty
secret: He proposed to Dr. Kirihara two years ago, was turned down, and still writes her poems he never sends.
voice: "YOUTH!", speaks in shouts, quotes old sports manga, cries at games.
description: Runs every PE class like a training camp. Adored by the baseball team, feared by everyone else.
appearance: Red tracksuit, whistle, towel round his neck, arms like logs.
